name: NDX breakdown + VIX-spike confirmation short — 4h crypto de-risk on equity-led risk-off with a fear tell
rationale: MECHANISM: same asymmetric downside-correlation thesis (crypto is the highest-beta sleeve cut first in an equity-led VaR risk-off), but requires a SECOND confirming stress tell — a VIX spike — before shorting, and runs on a 4h bar so the de-risk fires faster once the daily-available macro reads flip. Requiring BOTH ndx_index rolling over AND vix_level elevated filters the whipsaw regimes where NDX wobbles but there is no genuine cross-asset fear. Distinct from hh-macro-13 by the VIX confirmation (fewer, higher-conviction signals) and the faster bar. DISCONFIRMER: correlation is regime-unstable and both ndx and vix are daily FRED-style reads that a 4h bar cannot refresh intraday — the 4h frequency may just churn on stale macro. Kill if the two-tell version's avoided-drawdown net of extra round-trips and short funding does not beat the single-tell daily variant, or if it whipsaws when crypto decouples up (Oct-2025-style). Short pays funding — net-of-carry edge must clear it.
catalyst: equity breakdown with a confirming VIX fear spike
